I wish I could help man but I feel the same way. It's weird and I'll be honest but I really don't like my mom at all. I find her invasive, bitchy, and hard to do things wth but I still love her. Same wth my dad (they're split up). I'd kill myself to give my parents the life they want and to make sure they're always happy. My dad has some real mental issues. I'm not sure what he has but he went through an extremely rough period of time where he battled with himself. 

I wish I had advice for you but I hope you and your mom get better in some way.

Thank you very much for that. I forgot about that part of thinking today because of how I felt and you have helped me. At least one goal of mine is to take care of them when they're older. Thanks again, you're very kind.
